headline: WSN @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 3.94 at BOS 4.94, with a projected total of 8.87. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: WSN moved -0.28 runs while BOS moved +0.31, changing the projected margin by -0.59 runs. NRFI probability dropped -14.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cade Cavalli has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Anthony Seigler, Caleb Durbin, Luis García Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Romy Gonzalez, Carlos Narváez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
